name: Shop of Curiosities
source:
Welcome to Wynn's mysterious antique shop. Nestled in a building that everyone's eyes seem to sweep over, including yours. At least until one day—after a chance encounter—they don't.

In this store whose very existence is uncertain, you meet four strangers. Two who appear to share your situation, and two who may know more than they let on. What are the secrets they keep? And as the tides of change swell, who will weather them by your side?

Help a dejected MC stuck in their ways embrace change... or be carried along by it.

[From [url=https://a-citrus-sky.itch.io/shop-of-curiosities]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到永利神秘的古董店。坐落在一座所有人的目光都扫过的建筑里，包括你的。至少直到有一天——在一次偶然的相遇之后——他们都没有。

在这家存在不确定性的商店里，你遇到了四个陌生人。两个人看起来和你有同样的情况，还有两个人知道的事情可能比他们表现出来的要多。他们到底保守着什么秘密？当变革的浪潮汹涌澎湃时，谁会在你身边经受住考验？

帮助陷入困境的沮丧MC拥抱改变……或者被改变所带动。

[来自[url=https://a-citrus-sky.itch.io/shop-of-curiosities]itch.io[/url]]
